notes: family: hidden-role-social. No VP score. Schema cannot filter candidates by faction; resolve eligibility manually before marking won. Base full game; expansions excluded.
winCondition: Determine faction in priority order: Undead if both markers in war area; otherwise Water Folk if same or adjacent spaces; otherwise Empire if red leads by at least two, else Tribes. Only leaders aligned with that faction can win; no aligned leader means no winner.

tiebreakers.description: Among eligible leaders: most heroes of winning faction.
